image_description: A blue plastic rain barrel positioned outdoors against a light-colored textured wall. The barrel is cylindrical with horizontal reinforcing ribs. A white downspout pipe runs vertically along the left side, appearing to feed into the top of the barrel (though the connection point is partially obscured). Near the base, there are two spigots/taps installed. The barrel sits on a makeshift wooden stand or pallet. A yellow warning label is visible near the top rim.
